title: Collaborative Learning and Reasoning over Model Slices
abstract: arXiv:2610.12927v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel across diverse tasks, benefiting from knowledge priors, in-context reasoning, and test-time computation. Despite these strengths, single-model reasoning remains vulnerable to error propagation, as later steps depend on the model's earlier outputs, leaving reasoning blind spots difficult to independently reassess. To address this limitation, we develop \textit{collaborative learning}, encompassing the construction of heterogeneous collaborators and the learning of effective cross-model collaboration. Specifically, \textit{model slicing} replaces a large model with smaller, heterogeneous models under a comparable parameter budget, enabling prior reasoning to be reassessed across distinct model parameterizations. \textit{Pyramid supervision} combines protocol distillation with step-level supervision to refine reasoning and interaction decisions throughout collaboration. translated_title: 基于模型切片的协同学习与推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）凭借知识先验、上下文推理和测试时计算能力，在多种任务中表现出色。尽管具备这些优势，单模型推理仍然容易受到错误传播的影响，因为后续步骤依赖于模型先前的输出，导致推理中的盲点难以被独立地重新评估。为解决这一局限，我们开发了“协同学习”方法，涵盖异构协作者的构建以及有效跨模型协作的学习。具体而言，“模型切片”（model slicing）在可比参数预算下用更小的异构模型替代大模型，使先前的推理能够在不同的模型参数化之间得到重新评估。“金字塔监督”（pyramid supervision）将协议蒸馏与步骤级监督相结合，在整个协作过程中优化推理和交互决策。我们在四个……上评估了我们的方法。
tldr: 该论文提出“协同学习”框架，通过模型切片在同等参数预算下用多个异构小模型协作替代单一大模型，并借助金字塔监督优化跨模型推理与交互决策，从而解决单模型推理中错误传播和盲点难以重评的问题。
